title: Nightly backups
description: nightly-backups procedure: step exit codes (docker-event-watch), pack.sh's backup-manifest / backup-change lines the offsite rclone passes, and backup-photos' photo-originals sync. docs/services/backups.md#observability

panels.title: Overall (backup-verify)
panels.description: Exit code of backup-verify, the last step of nightly-backups and the single source of truth (it pages Pushover on any failure). From docker-event-watch die events on kdk-dkr-01, last 26 h.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({container="docker-event-watch", host="kdk-dkr-01"} |= "name=backup-verify-verify-1 " |= "action=die" | logfmt | unwrap code | __error__="" [26h]))

panels.title: Steps failed
panels.description: How many of the nightly one-shot steps (pgdump, rsync, gate, collect, pack, offsite, verify) last exited non-zero, last 26 h. 0 = every step exited 0. compose `run` containers (test runs) are ignored.

targets.expr: count(max by (host, name) (last_over_time({container="docker-event-watch"} |= "action=die" |= "name=backup-" | logfmt | name=~"backup-.+" | name!~".+-run-.+" | unwrap code | __error__="" [26h])) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Bytes produced
panels.description: Sum of every file in tonight's manifest (per-host archives, the 3d-prints archive and the pg dumps), from pack's backup-manifest lines, last 23 h. Each file counted once even if pack reported twice.

targets.expr: sum(max by (name) (last_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="pack"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [23h])))

panels.title: Upload passes
panels.description: rclone passes the offsite step needed, last 23 h (each pass is capped at 25 min; a pass that hits the cap exits 10 and the next one resumes, at most 6).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="offsite"} |= "offsite pass " [23h]))

panels.title: Upload time
panels.description: Wall time of all rclone passes, last 23 h, from the secs= field offsite.sh adds to each `offsite pass N` line (from PR A on; older lines have no secs= and show nothing).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="offsite"} |= "offsite pass " | regexp `secs=(?P<secs>[0-9]+)` | unwrap secs | __error__="" [23h]))

panels.title: On Proton
panels.description: The final `offsite rclone exit=` of the last 23 h. 0 = rclone reached a full sync, so every file in the table below is on Proton; anything else = the last pass did not finish (10 = time cap).

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="offsite"} |= "offsite rclone exit=" | regexp `offsite rclone exit=(?P<rc>[0-9]+)` | unwrap rc | __error__="" [23h]))

panels.title: Steps: latest exit code
panels.description: Latest exit code of every nightly step container (docker-event-watch `action=die code=N`), last 26 h. 15 steps: dkr-01 pgdump-jellystat, pgdump-wger, rsync, gate, collect, collect gate, verify; dmz-01 pgdump-authelia, -immich, -tandoor, rsync, gate; dkr-04 pack, offsite, gate.

targets.expr: max by (host, name) (last_over_time({container="docker-event-watch"} |= "action=die" |= "name=backup-" | logfmt | name=~"backup-.+" | name!~".+-run-.+" | unwrap code | __error__="" [26h]))

panels.title: Steps per night
panels.description: Worst exit code of each step per UTC day (the run at 09:20 UTC = 03:20 CST lands in its own day). Green 0, red anything else, empty = the step did not run that day.

targets.expr: max by (name) (max_over_time({container="docker-event-watch"} |= "action=die" |= "name=backup-" | logfmt | name=~"backup-.+" | name!~".+-run-.+" | unwrap code | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Files produced tonight
panels.description: One row per file in tonight's backup-manifest (pack.sh, plus one `kind=photos` row per photo source from backup-photos' photos.sh, last 23 h). prev = the same series' previous file (yesterday's archive, the previous dump of that DB). % of prev is red below 50 (the BackupFileShrank alert). Proton = the last `offsite rclone exit=` (0 = the whole set synced). Empty before PR A's pack.sh has run. Photo rows: size = the whole source tree; prev = the last accepted night; Proton = the final `photos rclone exit=` (10 while the first upload seeds), `left out` = the deletion guard refused that source tonight.

targets.expr: max by (kind, host, series, name, col) (last_over_time({stack=~"backup-offsite|backup-photos", service=~"pack|photos"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | label_format col="size" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [23h]))

max by (kind, host, series, name, col) (last_over_time({stack=~"backup-offsite|backup-photos", service=~"pack|photos"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | label_format col="prev size" | prev_bytes!="none" | unwrap prev_bytes | __error__="" [23h]))

max by (kind, host, series, name, col) (last_over_time({stack=~"backup-offsite|backup-photos", service=~"pack|photos"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | label_format col="change" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [23h])) - max by (kind, host, series, name, col) (last_over_time({stack=~"backup-offsite|backup-photos", service=~"pack|photos"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | label_format col="change" | prev_bytes!="none" | unwrap prev_bytes | __error__="" [23h]))

max by (kind, host, series, name, col) (last_over_time({stack=~"backup-offsite|backup-photos", service=~"pack|photos"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | label_format col="% of prev" | pct!="none" | unwrap pct | __error__="" [23h]))

max by (kind, host, series, name, col) (last_over_time({stack=~"backup-offsite|backup-photos", service=~"pack|photos"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | kind!="photos" | label_format col="Proton" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [23h])) * 0 + on() group_left() max(last_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="offsite"} |= "offsite rclone exit=" | regexp `offsite rclone exit=(?P<rc>[0-9]+)` | unwrap rc | __error__="" [23h]))

max by (kind, host, series, name, col) (last_over_time({stack="backup-photos", service="photos"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | kind="photos" | guard="ok" | label_format col="Proton" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [23h])) * 0 + on() group_left() max(last_over_time({stack="backup-photos", service="photos"} |= "photos rclone exit=" |= "remote=proton" | regexp `photos rclone exit=(?P<rc>[0-9]+)` | unwrap rc | __error__="" [23h]))

max by (kind, host, series, name, col) (last_over_time({stack="backup-photos", service="photos"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | kind="photos" | guard!="ok" | label_format col="Proton" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [23h])) * 0 + 900

panels.title: Host archives
panels.description: Size of each <host>-DATE.tar.zst and 3d-prints-DATE.tar.zst per night (backup-manifest kind=archive), log scale: kdk-dkr-04's archive is ~118 B, kdk-dkr-01's ~5 GB. Panel range 30 d (Loki retention).

targets.expr: max by (series) (max_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="pack"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | kind="archive" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Database dumps
panels.description: Size of each pg dump per night (backup-manifest kind=pgdump), series = the database. Panel range 30 d.

targets.expr: max by (host, series) (max_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="pack"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | kind="pgdump" | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Files changed per night
panels.description: From backup-change-summary: files added / changed (size or mtime) / removed between the newest 3d-prints archive and the previous one. A baseline night (no previous archive) reports 0.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="pack"} |= "backup-change-summary " | logfmt | unwrap added | __error__="" [$__interval]))
max(max_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="pack"} |= "backup-change-summary " | logfmt | unwrap changed | __error__="" [$__interval]))
max(max_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="pack"} |= "backup-change-summary " | logfmt | unwrap removed | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Changed paths
panels.description: backup-change lines (at most 300 per night) and the night's summary line (truncated=true when more than 300 changed; baseline=true on the first archive). Paths are relative to ~/cad.

targets.expr: {stack="backup-offsite", service="pack"} |~ "^backup-change(-summary)? " | logfmt | line_format `{{.date}} {{if .op}}{{.op}} {{.path}}{{else}}summary added={{.added}} changed={{.changed}} removed={{.removed}} truncated={{.truncated}}{{if eq .baseline "true"}} baseline (first archive){{end}}{{end}}`

panels.title: Exit code per pass per night
panels.description: rclone exit of each `offsite pass N` per UTC day. 0 = in sync (the loop stops), 10 = hit the 25-min cap (the next pass resumes), anything else = errors. Several runs in one day show the worst.

targets.expr: max by (pass) (max_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="offsite"} |= "offsite pass " | regexp `offsite pass (?P<pass>[0-9]+): rclone exit=(?P<rc>[0-9]+)` | unwrap rc | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Passes per night
panels.description: Number of `offsite pass N` lines per UTC day (two runs in one day add up).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="offsite"} |= "offsite pass " [$__interval]))

panels.title: Upload time per night
panels.description: Sum of the per-pass secs= per UTC day (offsite.sh from PR A on).

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({stack="backup-offsite", service="offsite"} |= "offsite pass " | regexp `secs=(?P<secs>[0-9]+)` | unwrap secs | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Photo originals (backup-photos to Proton, file by file)
Photos on Proton
panels.description: The final `photos rclone exit=` (remote=proton) of the last 23 h. 0 = every accepted source is in sync; 10 = the 4 x 25-min passes ran out (normal while the first upload seeds over several nights); 7 = --max-delete hit; 90 = every source refused by the deletion guard. backup-verify decides FAIL/WARN.

targets.expr: max(last_over_time({stack="backup-photos", service="photos"} |= "photos rclone exit=" |= "remote=proton" | regexp `photos rclone exit=(?P<rc>[0-9]+)` | unwrap rc | __error__="" [23h]))

panels.title: Photos: exit per pass per night
panels.description: rclone exit of each `photos pass N` per UTC day. 0 = in sync, 10 = the 25-min cap (next pass / next night resumes), 7 = --max-delete exceeded.

targets.expr: max by (pass) (max_over_time({stack="backup-photos", service="photos"} |= "photos pass " |= "remote=proton" | regexp `photos pass (?P<pass>[0-9]+): remote=proton rclone exit=(?P<rc>[0-9]+)` | unwrap rc | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Photo sources: files
panels.description: File count of each photo source per night (backup-manifest kind=photos `files=`). A drop is what the deletion guard (< 50 % of the last accepted night) and BackupFileShrank watch.

targets.expr: max by (series) (max_over_time({stack="backup-photos", service="photos"} |= "backup-manifest " | logfmt | kind="photos" | unwrap files | __error__="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Photos: upload time per night
panels.description: Sum of the per-pass secs= of `photos pass N` per UTC day. ~100 min (4 x 25) every night = still seeding.

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({stack="backup-photos", service="photos"} |= "photos pass " | regexp `secs=(?P<secs>[0-9]+)` | unwrap secs | __error__="" [$__interval]))
